prompt: The staging cluster of quote-service/ has no Gateway API; it runs ingress-nginx (IngressClass `nginx`). Publish staging at quotes.staging.acme.dev through it, and prove that a staging deploy would render, without deploying anything.

checks.expr: get(data, 'gateway.enabled') is False and get(data, 'ingress.enabled') is True and get(data, 'ingress.className') == 'nginx' and get(data, 'ingress.hostname') == 'quotes.staging.acme.dev'
checks.why: values-staging.yaml: gateway.enabled false, ingress.{enabled, className, hostname}
values.yaml is shared by every environment; other environments must not change

reference: In values-staging.yaml: `gateway.enabled: false` and `ingress: {enabled: true, className: nginx, hostname: quotes.staging.acme.dev}` (values.yaml and the other environments unchanged), then `graph-agents-cli deploy --env staging --dry-run` renders the Ingress (it reads .env.staging).
